description: This source file defines an interface IBlockPoolMonitor for monitoring block pool metrics related to memory management in cache systems, and a class ObjectPoolMonitorBridge that acts as a bridge between object count based metrics and memory size based metrics within Orleans cache infrastructure.

classes.name: ObjectPoolMonitorBridge
classes.description: A class that implements IObjectPoolMonitor and bridges object count metrics to memory size metrics for block pools in Orleans cache infrastructure.

methods.name: ObjectPoolMonitorBridge
methods.description: Constructor initializing the bridge with a block pool monitor and block size in bytes.

methods.name: TrackObjectAllocated
methods.description: Increments memory allocated metrics based on block size when an object is allocated.

methods.name: TrackObjectReleased
methods.description: Decrements memory metrics based on block size when an object is released.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Reports current block pool status by converting object counts to memory size and forwarding to the block pool monitor.
